title: Deploying Node.js Applications
description: Learn how to deploy Node.js applications to production environments reliably and securely. This module covers deployment options, server setup, environment configuration, and best practices to ensure your app runs smoothly.

lessons.title: Introduction to Deployment
lessons.content: Understand what deployment means in the context of Node.js applications. Learn about different deployment environments, goals of deployment, and challenges developers face when moving from development to production.

lessons.title: Preparing Your Node.js App for Deployment
lessons.content: Learn essential steps to prepare your app for deployment including environment variable setup, dependency management, and optimizing the app for production.

lessons.title: Choosing a Hosting Platform
lessons.content: Explore popular hosting options for Node.js apps such as cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), Platform-as-a-Service (Heroku, Vercel), and VPS providers. Understand their pros and cons.

lessons.title: Deploying on a Virtual Private Server (VPS)
lessons.content: Step-by-step guide on deploying a Node.js app on a VPS using SSH, setting up Node.js and NPM, and running your app with process managers like PM2.

lessons.title: Using Process Managers (PM2, Forever)
lessons.content: Learn how to keep your Node.js application running continuously using process managers like PM2 or Forever, including automatic restarts and monitoring.

lessons.title: Configuring a Reverse Proxy with Nginx
lessons.content: Understand how to use Nginx as a reverse proxy to handle incoming HTTP requests, improve security, enable HTTPS, and balance loads.

lessons.title: Environment Variables and Configuration Management
lessons.content: Learn best practices for managing sensitive information and configuration through environment variables using tools like dotenv and config files.

lessons.title: Deploying on Cloud Platforms
lessons.content: Step-by-step deployment on popular cloud providers like AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Google App Engine, and Microsoft Azure, including setting up databases and scaling.

lessons.title: Using Docker for Containerized Deployment
lessons.content: Introduction to containerizing your Node.js app using Docker. Learn how to write Dockerfiles, build images, and deploy containers to cloud or local servers.

lessons.title: Security and Performance Best Practices in Deployment
lessons.content: Explore security measures such as HTTPS, securing APIs, handling secrets safely, and optimizing performance with caching, compression, and monitoring tools.
